title: Theres A Person There
original_lyrics:
[verse]
She walks around the block with silver plated cutter on her shoulder to

[chorus]
Everybody thinks she's crazy. I think maybe she just needs patient ear to
listen to her stories, let her know somebody cares and there's person there.
I gave her pair of shoes for Christmas. She looked up and smiled and
said somebody must've listened.
I got shoes on. My feet are off the ground. Thank you Jesus, this old
world won't get me down. As long as I got prayers to pay and

[bridge]
Last one she told me she was all down on her luck when the landlord wanted
her to kill her ex for little money and truck. Mmm, but I ain't scared.
Layin' in my bed I hear the water run, the ceiling creak, I don't think she ever
sleeps. But I love to hear those feet upstairs 'cause there's person there.
Who knows? Maybe I'm litte crazy too. But crazy people always seem to
pull each other through.
I got shoes on. My feet are off the ground. Thank you Jesus, this old
world won't get me down. As long as I got prayers to pay and

[bridge]
I got shoes on. My feet are off the ground. Thank you Jesus, this old
world won't get me down. As long as I got prayers to pay and

[bridge]
Her name's Sophia but she makes me call her mama and I don't mind 'cause my
family's far away. It's nice sometimes, when life ain't fair, to know there's
person there.
